Actually i told you something was bad and explained why it was. That is known as showing evidence for your claim. Well here is the logic behind why sprint was bad in the fourth installment. Due to the increased movement speed it you have to pace your shots for greater distances in order to take out a sprinting target so in the fourth installment the maps all had large pacing to match the new movement speed. This means it created large open spaces, exaggerated sightlines and made movement options fairly linear (meaning that due to the map scaling increase, the movement options you have are too far away therefore you are far more predictable to a foe which natural decreases the dynamics of gameplay). Also due to this we get cat and mouse like gameplay of players preferring to run away and be chased down, which is very similar to the rival shooter's style of gameplay, rather than sticking in the fight or finding an interesting route to flank the opponent.
